notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.notes: [p]Hi everybody. I've updated the Demo one last time, before it's time to lock things down for a while. This version of the Demo has a number of changes:[/p][olist][*][p]It's now a [i]lot[/i] faster to get into the gameplay. One quick (skippable) cutscene. Apparently, the previous version might have taken too long for the players who just wanted to get straight into the action, so I've made this change to see if that can entice more of you to give this a go long enough to play it a bit![/p][/*][*][p]There are a bunch of new weapons and other things. I'm not going to spoil all of that here, but several of them can be crafted during the Demo. Have fun![/p][/*][*][p]Minor tweaks to a few features. The Demo's pretty stable at this point, but there is always room for improvement.[/p][/*][/olist][p]This will [i]probably[/i] be the last Demo update. I wish it wasn't so, but I'm on the downward slope to complete the game, and I probably can't spare more time to tweak the Demo for the next month or two. If you'd care to leave any feedback about your experience with the Demo, I'd appreciate it, as it helps me improve the game and it helps a bit with Steam's algo.[/p][previewyoutube="lNcqS_BizqA;full"][/previewyoutube]
